basic_info.description: Welcome to 1339 16th Avenue, No. 3 - where modern flare meets San Francisco charm in this stylish 3 bedroom plus office, 2 bathroom, European style flat situated in a boutique Inner Sunset building. This home was beautifully remodeled down to the studs, and offers a flexible floor plan with endless possibilities to entertain, lounge, host guests, or work from home. Enjoy gorgeous hardwood floors with modern updates, and natural light throughout. The living area features a brand-new open concept kitchen with stainless steel appliances, gas stove, and chic Quartz countertops. Down the hall are three bedrooms with a separate fourth bedroom, perfect for a home office, additional guest rooms, and flexibility for all lifestyles. Pamper yourself in the two luxurious, spa-like bathrooms with custom tiling and generous walk-in showers. Additional highlights include in-unit washer & dryer, 1 car independent parking, and hydronic heating. With a stellar 96 Walk Score in the thriving Inner Sunset, you're just steps from everything you need. Indulge in easy access to Golden Gate Park, UCSF, trendy dining & shopping spots on Irving St, and the N Judah MUNI line for seamless commuting. Welcome to your new home!
